newsitem.title: USA: Consolidated Health gets acquisition proposal.
newsitem.headline: Consolidated Health gets acquisition proposal.

text.p: Consolidated Health Care Associate Inc said it signed a non-binding letter of intent for Olympus Healthcare Group Inc to acquire substantially all of the operating assets and assume certain liabilities of Consolidated.
The company said Olympus will pay about $5 million for Consolidated, consisting of 175,620 shares of common stock of Olympus and $750,000 cash.
The deal is subject to completion of due diligence, signing of a definitive agreement and the approval of Consolidated shareholders and certain other customary conditions.
Consolidated said it expects the deal to close in October.
Consolidated operates rehabilitation clinics and offers home health rehabilitation services.
Olympus provides post acute health services in New England.
